title: 1 Knight vs 100 Pawns
summary: Player's king and one knight vs Martin's king and 100 pawns on a wide board (~20 files x ~10 ranks). The creator hunts free pawns, waits for holes, and eventually checkmates Martin's king trapped inside its own pawn mass (mate in two found near 13:05).
rules: Wide board, about 20 files x 10 ranks (frames).
Black (Martin): king plus 100 pawns filling about five ranks.
Normal chess rules; Martin's pawns promote (to queen etc.) on the player's back rank; Martin never misses mate-in-one / always stops mate-in-one.
win_condition: Checkmate Martin (typically by trapping his king among his own pawns).

board.shape_notes: wide rectangular board (~20x10) to fit 100 pawns
board.theme_notes: chess.com green/cream (#eaf6d2/#7ea25a), neo set; purple move highlights

setup: 20x10: Black king on top rank, 100 black pawns on ~5 ranks (20 per rank) below it; White king + knight on the bottom rank (exact squares not verified).
evidence: Transcript 0:01 '100 pawns with one knight against Martin'; 0:06 sea of pawns promoting; 2:51 first promotion; 13:05-13:25 mate in two, 'beat Martin with a king and a knight versus 100 pawns'. Visual line: ~20x10 board, ~100 pawns filling ~5 ranks, Martin (250). Exact dimensions are frame estimates.
